version: 0.1.0
kind: workspace-folder
metadata:
  name: system.temp
  description: Temporary scratch files created during workspace execution and safe to discard.
spec:
  path: .workspace/system.temp
  lifecycle: volatile
  tracking: ignored
  volatility: high
  naming:
    reserved_files:
      - _root.yaml
      - "*.temp.yaml"
    versioning: semver
